b'# tinydl

A tiny command-line downloader.

## Usage

```
tinydl URL [-o OUTPUT] [-q]
```

## Options

| Option | Long option | Help text |
|--------|-------------|-----------|
| `url` | \xe2\x80\x94 | what to download |
| `-o` | `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q` | `--quiet` | no progress output |

## Description

`tinydl` downloads a resource from the given URL and writes it to a file or stdout. It retries failed connections up to 3 times with exponential back-off. By default it prints the number of bytes downloaded to stderr; use `-q` to suppress that output.
'
